waveform.title: Waveform Display
waveform.description: Shows the shape of the sound wave. It plots the amplitude (volume) of the sound over its short duration.
waveform.technical: A time-domain representation of the audio buffer. The Y-axis is amplitude (-1 to 1) and the X-axis is time.

spectrum.title: Frequency Spectrum
spectrum.description: Visualizes which frequencies (low to high) are present in the sound. Taller bars mean that frequency is more prominent.
spectrum.technical: A frequency-domain representation derived from a Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT). The X-axis is frequency (logarithmic scale) and the Y-axis is magnitude.

amplitudeMeter.title: Amplitude Meter
amplitudeMeter.description: Displays the sound's volume levels. RMS is the average volume, while PEAK shows the loudest single point.
amplitudeMeter.technical: Calculates Root Mean Square (RMS) and Peak amplitude, converting them to decibels (dBFS). A peak near 0dB indicates potential clipping.

amplitudeEnvelope.title: Volume Envelope
amplitudeEnvelope.description: Shows the overall shape of the sound's volume from start to finish. This is shaped by the Attack, Sustain, and Decay parameters.
amplitudeEnvelope.technical: Calculates the RMS amplitude over small time windows to plot the sound's overall amplitude contour over its full duration.

waveformType.title: Waveform Type
waveformType.description:
The fundamental building block of the sound. Each shape has a unique harmonic content and character.

• Square: Bright, buzzy, hollow. Classic retro game sound.
• Sawtooth: Rich, sharp, full. Great for leads and basses.
• Sine: Pure, smooth, clean. The most basic tone with no overtones.
• Noise: Hissy and random. Used for percussion and effects like wind or explosions.
waveformType.technical: Sets the oscillator's fundamental shape. Square waves contain odd harmonics, Sawtooth waves contain all harmonics, and Sine waves contain only the fundamental frequency.

noiseType.title: Noise Type
noiseType.description:
Different 'colors' of noise, each with a different balance of frequencies.

• White: Hissy static with equal energy across all frequencies.
• Pink: Deeper, like a waterfall, with less high-frequency content.
• Brown: A low rumble, like distant thunder, emphasizing bass frequencies.
noiseType.technical: Describes the power spectral density. White noise is flat (equal power per Hz). Pink noise power drops 3dB per octave. Brown(ian) noise power drops 6dB per octave.

p_base_freq.label: Base Freq
p_base_freq.title: Base Frequency
p_base_freq.description: Controls the fundamental pitch of the sound. Higher values create higher-pitched sounds.
p_base_freq.technical: Normalized frequency value, where 1.0 is approximately 440Hz (A4). The range is clamped between 20Hz and 20kHz during synthesis.

p_freq_ramp.label: Freq Ramp
p_freq_ramp.title: Frequency Ramp (Slide)
p_freq_ramp.description: Makes the pitch slide up (positive) or down (negative) over the sound's duration.
p_freq_ramp.technical: A linear modulation added to the base frequency over time. Creates sweeps, risers, and dive-bomb effects.

p_freq_limit.label: Freq Floor
p_freq_limit.title: Frequency Floor
p_freq_limit.description: Sets a minimum pitch for downward frequency slides, preventing them from becoming inaudibly low.
p_freq_limit.technical: A lower bound for the frequency. Useful for sounds like lasers or impacts that slide down but shouldn't disappear.

p_repeat_speed.label: Retrigger
p_repeat_speed.title: Retrigger Rate
p_repeat_speed.description: Rapidly re-triggers the sound's envelope, creating a stuttering or buzzing effect.
p_repeat_speed.technical: Applies a sawtooth-like amplitude modulation to the envelope, simulating rapid re-triggering at a rate proportional to this value.

p_env_attack.label: Attack
p_env_attack.title: Attack Time
p_env_attack.description: How quickly the sound fades in from silence to its maximum volume.
p_env_attack.technical: The duration of the Attack phase of the ADSR envelope, in seconds. A value of 0 is instantaneous.

p_env_sustain.label: Sustain
p_env_sustain.title: Sustain Time
p_env_sustain.description: How long the sound holds its volume after the initial attack.
p_env_sustain.technical: The duration of the Sustain phase of the ADSR envelope, in seconds.

p_env_decay.label: Decay
p_env_decay.title: Decay Time
p_env_decay.description: How quickly the sound fades out to silence after the sustain period ends.
p_env_decay.technical: The duration of the Decay phase of the ADSR envelope, in seconds.

p_env_punch.label: Punch
p_env_punch.title: Sustain Punch
p_env_punch.description: Adds an initial volume boost at the beginning of the sustain phase, creating a more percussive or 'punchy' sound.
p_env_punch.technical: An amplitude boost applied at the start of the sustain phase which then decays, creating a secondary attack-decay shape within the sustain.

p_vib_speed.label: Vib Speed
p_vib_speed.title: Vibrato Speed
p_vib_speed.description: Controls how fast the pitch wavers up and down (vibrato).
p_vib_speed.technical: The frequency of the Low-Frequency Oscillator (LFO) that modulates the pitch.

p_vib_strength.label: Vib Depth
p_vib_strength.title: Vibrato Depth
p_vib_strength.description: Controls how much the pitch wavers up and down (vibrato depth).
p_vib_strength.technical: The amplitude of the LFO that modulates the pitch, determining the intensity of the vibrato effect.

distortion.label: Distortion
distortion.title: Distortion
distortion.description: Adds warmth, grit, and aggressive harmonics by clipping the waveform.
distortion.technical: Applies a hyperbolic tangent `tanh(x)` waveshaping algorithm to the signal, adding odd harmonics.

bit_crush.label: Bit Crush
bit_crush.title: Bit Crush
bit_crush.description: Reduces the sound's digital resolution, creating a crunchy, lo-fi, retro video game sound.
bit_crush.technical: Quantizes the signal's amplitude to a lower bit depth, introducing quantization error noise.

p_lpf_freq.label: Low Pass
p_lpf_freq.title: Low-Pass Filter
p_lpf_freq.description: Cuts high frequencies, making the sound darker, more muffled, or appear farther away.
p_lpf_freq.technical: The cutoff frequency of a simple one-pole low-pass filter. Value of 1.0 means the filter is fully open (no effect).

p_hpf_freq.label: High Pass
p_hpf_freq.title: High-Pass Filter
p_hpf_freq.description: Cuts low frequencies, making the sound thinner, tinnier, or removing unwanted bass rumble.
p_hpf_freq.technical: The cutoff frequency of a simple one-pole high-pass filter. Value of 0.0 means the filter has no effect.

chorus_rate.label: Chorus
chorus_rate.title: Chorus Rate
chorus_rate.description: The speed of the warbling, shimmering chorus effect.
chorus_rate.technical: The modulation rate of the chorus effect's delay line, creating a sense of multiple voices.

delay_time.label: Delay
delay_time.title: Delay Time
delay_time.description: The time between the original sound and its first echo.
delay_time.technical: The length of the delay buffer, determining the time until the delayed signal is played back.

fm_freq.label: FM Freq
fm_freq.title: FM Frequency
fm_freq.description: The pitch of the modulating oscillator in Frequency Modulation (FM) synthesis. Creates complex, metallic, or bell-like tones.
fm_freq.technical: Sets the frequency of a secondary (modulator) oscillator whose output modifies the primary (carrier) oscillator's frequency.

fm_depth.label: FM Depth
fm_depth.title: FM Depth
fm_depth.description: The intensity of the FM synthesis effect.
fm_depth.technical: The amplitude of the modulator oscillator, determining how strongly it affects the carrier's frequency.

ring_mod_freq.label: Ring Freq
ring_mod_freq.title: Ring Mod Frequency
ring_mod_freq.description: The frequency of the carrier wave for the ring modulator. Creates dissonant, robotic, and metallic textures.
ring_mod_freq.technical: The frequency of the sine wave that the input signal is multiplied by, producing sum and difference frequencies.

ring_mod_depth.label: Ring Depth
ring_mod_depth.title: Ring Mod Depth
ring_mod_depth.description: The mix amount of the ring modulation effect.
ring_mod_depth.technical: Controls the wet/dry mix between the original signal and the ring-modulated signal.

delay_feedback.label: Feedback
delay_feedback.title: Delay Feedback
delay_feedback.description: Controls how many echoes are produced by the delay effect. High values can lead to runaway, loud sounds.
delay_feedback.technical: The amount of the delayed signal that is fed back into the delay line's input.

sound_vol.label: Volume
sound_vol.title: Master Volume
sound_vol.description: The final volume of this specific sound patch. This is applied before the global master volume.
sound_vol.technical: A final linear amplitude multiplier for the generated buffer. Value of 1.0 represents 0dBFS (no change).
